findings.title: U-3V3RF (TPS63031DSKR) estimated Tj 150°C exceeds abs max 125°C
findings.description: ldo dissipates 0.831W in unknown package (Rθ_JA=150°C/W). Source: (5.0V - 3.3V) × 0.489A.
findings.recommendation: Reduce power dissipation (lower Vin, reduce load), improve thermal path (add thermal vias, larger copper pour), or use a more efficient topology (switching regulator instead of LDO).

findings.title: U-3V3RF (TPS63031DSKR) dissipates 0.83W with no thermal vias
findings.description: ldo in unknown package dissipates 0.831W but no thermal pad vias were detected. Heat removal relies entirely on surface copper.
findings.recommendation: Add thermal vias under the component's thermal pad or exposed pad. Minimum 5 vias for QFN, more for larger pads.
findings.summary: U-3V3RF (TPS63031DSKR) dissipates 0.83W with no thermal vias

findings.title: MLCC C-IN1 is 3.0mm from U-3V3RF (TPS63031DSKR) (Tj=150°C)
findings.description: Ceramic capacitors lose effective capacitance at elevated temperatures. X7R loses ~15% at 85°C, X5R loses ~30%.
findings.recommendation: Verify capacitor maintains adequate capacitance at the elevated temperature, or use C0G/NP0 dielectric for temperature-critical applications.
